questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है:
अभिकथन (A): जीएसटी व्यवस्था के तहत, सभी पेट्रोलियम उत्पादों पर मूल्य वर्धित कर (VAT) और केंद्रीय उत्पाद शुल्क को तुरंत समाप्त कर दिया गया और जीएसटी में समाहित कर लिया गया।
कारण (R): भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 279A(5) के तहत, जीएसटी परिषद को पेट्रोलियम क्रूड, हाई-स्पीड डीजल, मोटर स्पिरिट (पेट्रोल), प्राकृतिक गैस और एविएशन टर्बाइन फ्यूल (ATF) पर जिस तारीख से जीएसटी लगाया जाएगा, उसकी सिफारिश करने का संवैधानिक अधिकार प्राप्त है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनिए:
options_hindi: (A) और (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है
(A) और (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Under the GST regime, Value Added Tax (VAT) and Central Excise Duty on all petroleum products were immediately abolished and subsumed into GST.
Reason (R): Under Article 279A(5) of the Constitution of India, the GST Council is constitutionally empowered to recommend the date from which GST shall be levied on petroleum crude, high-speed diesel, motor spirit (petrol), natural gas, and aviation turbine fuel (ATF).
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is false: Petroleum products were not immediately subsumed into GST, nor was VAT or Central Excise Duty on them abolished. Five specified petroleum products—petroleum crude, high-speed diesel (HSD), motor spirit (commonly known as petrol), natural gas, and aviation turbine fuel (ATF)—were kept temporarily outside the scope of GST. They continue to attract Central Excise Duty levied by the Central Government and State VAT/Sales Tax levied by State Governments.
Reason (R) is true: Under Article 279A(5) of the Constitution of India (as inserted by the 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016), the Goods and Services Tax Council has been given the constitutional mandate to recommend the date from which GST will be levied on these five petroleum products. Until the GST Council makes such a recommendation and a notification is issued, existing taxes (VAT and Excise) continue to apply.
Therefore, Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) असत्य है: जीएसटी लागू होने पर पेट्रोलियम उत्पादों पर वैट (VAT) और केंद्रीय उत्पाद शुल्क समाप्त नहीं हुए थे और न ही इन्हें तुरंत जीएसटी में समाहित किया गया था। पाँच प्रमुख पेट्रोलियम उत्पादों—पेट्रोलियम कच्चा तेल (क्रूड), हाई-स्पीड डीजल, मोटर स्पिरिट (पेट्रोल), प्राकृतिक गैस और विमानन टरबाइन ईंधन (ATF)—को अस्थायी रूप से जीएसटी के दायरे से बाहर रखा गया है। इन पर आज भी केंद्र सरकार द्वारा केंद्रीय उत्पाद शुल्क और राज्यों द्वारा वैट/बिक्री कर लगाया जाता है।
कारण (R) सत्य है: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 279A(5) (101वें संविधान संशोधन द्वारा अंतःस्थापित) के अनुसार, जीएसटी परिषद को यह संवैधानिक शक्ति दी गई है कि वह उस तिथि की सिफारिश करेगी जिससे इन पाँचों पेट्रोलियम उत्पादों पर जीएसटी लगाया जाएगा। जब तक परिषद इसकी सिफारिश नहीं करती, तब तक ये पुरानी कर प्रणाली के अधीन ही रहेंगे।
अतः अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परंतु कारण (R) सत्य है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Value Added Tax on key petroleum products was not abolished upon the introduction of GST. Under Article 279A(5) of the Constitution, petroleum crude, high-speed diesel, motor spirit, natural gas, and aviation turbine fuel remain temporarily outside GST, awaiting a decision by the GST Council regarding their date of inclusion.

questions.question_hindi: एक सरकारी स्कूल बाहरी छात्रों को आमंत्रित करते हुए एक ग्रीष्मकालीन शिविर (समर कैंप) आयोजित करता है, जिसमें शौक कक्षाओं (जैसे मिट्टी के बर्तन बनाना, उन्नत रोबोटिक्स) के लिए प्रति छात्र ₹1,000 का शुल्क लिया जाता है, जो किसी मान्यता प्राप्त योग्यता का हिस्सा नहीं हैं। जीएसटी के तहत इसे किस प्रकार माना जाएगा?
options_hindi: कर-मुक्त, क्योंकि स्कूल भवन में आयोजित कोई भी गतिविधि स्वतः कर-मुक्त होती है।
कर-मुक्त, क्योंकि भागीदारी शुल्क प्रति छात्र ₹5,000 से कम है।
केवल तभी करयोग्य जब सभी पाठ्यक्रमों से कुल वार्षिक शुल्क संग्रह ₹20 लाख से अधिक हो जाए।
करयोग्य (Taxable), क्योंकि मनोरंजक/शौक गतिविधियाँ किसी विधि द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त योग्यता प्रदान नहीं करती हैं।

questions.question_english: A government school conducts a summer camp inviting external students, charging a participation fee of ₹1,000 per student for hobby and recreational classes (e.g., pottery, advanced robotics) that do not form part of any prescribed curriculum leading to a recognized qualification. How is this transaction treated under GST?
options_english: Exempt, as any activity conducted within a school building is automatically exempt.
Exempt, because the participation fee is below ₹5,000 per student.
Taxable only if the total annual fee collection from all courses exceeds ₹20 lakhs.
Taxable, because recreational hobby activities do not lead to a legally recognized qualification.
questions.explanation_english: Under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), the statutory exemption for educational institutions under Entry 66 applies strictly to: (i) pre-school education and education up to higher secondary school or equivalent, (ii) education as part of a curriculum for obtaining a qualification recognized by any law for the time being in force, or (iii) approved vocational courses. Recreational summer camps, commercial hobby classes, or informal training provided to non-enrolled external students do not form part of a curriculum leading to a recognized qualification. Therefore, such standalone commercial activities fail to meet the exemption criteria and are taxable under GST.
questions.explanation_hindi: अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017-केंद्रीय कर (दर) के तहत प्रविष्टि 66 के अंतर्गत शैक्षणिक संस्थानों को मिलने वाली जीएसटी छूट केवल ऐसी शिक्षा पर लागू होती है जो पूर्व-प्राथमिक से 12वीं तक की नियमित शिक्षा हो, अथवा किसी कानून द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त डिग्री/डिप्लोमा प्राप्त करने वाले पाठ्यक्रम का हिस्सा हो। बाहरी छात्रों के लिए आयोजित हॉबी क्लासेस या समर कैंप किसी कानून द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक योग्यता प्रदान नहीं करते हैं। अतः ये गतिविधियाँ शैक्षणिक छूट के दायरे में नहीं आती हैं और इन पर ली जाने वाली फीस जीएसटी के तहत करयोग्य (Taxable) होती है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (d) Taxable, as recreational activities do not lead to a recognized qualification.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: lead to a recognized qualification. Services supplied by an educational institution are exempt from GST only when they relate to education that leads to a qualification recognized by Indian law. Organizing recreational summer camps or commercial hobby classes for external non-enrolled students does not grant recognized qualifications, rendering such participation fees fully taxable under GST.

questions.question_hindi: एक विद्यालय को आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा में यह आपत्ति प्राप्त होती है कि डीडीओ द्वारा डेटा प्रविष्टि की त्रुटि के कारण नवीनतम फॉर्म 24Q में कई शिक्षकों की प्रविष्टियाँ "PAN Invalid" (अमान्य पैन) के रूप में चिह्नित हैं। संबंधित कर्मचारियों पर इस लिपिकीय त्रुटि का तात्कालिक प्रभाव क्या होगा?
options_hindi: आयकर विभाग द्वारा कर्मचारियों के व्यक्तिगत बैंक खातों को तुरंत फ्रीज (freeze) कर दिया जाएगा।
कर्मचारियों पर जानबूझकर कर चोरी के आरोप में आयकर विभाग द्वारा तत्काल मुकदमा चलाया जाएगा।
वेतन से काटा गया टीडीएस कर्मचारियों के फॉर्म 26AS/AIS में प्रदर्शित नहीं होगा, जिससे वे आईटीआर दाखिल करते समय टैक्स क्रेडिट का दावा नहीं कर पाएंगे।
कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ेगा, क्योंकि आयकर विभाग का सिस्टम स्वतः ही कर्मचारियों के नामों का सही पैन (PAN) से मिलान कर लेता है।

questions.question_english: A school audit notes that several teacher entries in the latest Form 24Q are marked as "PAN Invalid" due to clerical data entry errors by the DDO. What is the immediate consequence of this error on the concerned employees?
options_english: The employees' personal bank accounts will be immediately frozen by the tax department.
The employees will face immediate criminal prosecution for willful tax evasion.
The deducted TDS will not reflect in their Form 26AS/AIS, preventing them from claiming tax credit when filing their annual ITR.
There is no impact, because the department's system automatically maps names to the correct PANs.
questions.explanation_english: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) is strictly mapped and credited in the Income Tax Department's central database using the employee's 10-character Permanent Account Number (PAN). If the DDO enters an invalid or erroneous PAN in Form 24Q, the Central Processing Cell (CPC-TDS) cannot map the tax payment to the employee's tax ledger. Consequently, the deducted tax fails to appear in the employee's Form 26AS and Annual Information Statement (AIS). When the employee files their Income Tax Return (ITR), the tax department's automated system disallows the TDS credit claim, resulting in an unjustified tax demand notice with interest under Section 234B/234C. To resolve this, the DDO must immediately file a C3 correction statement on TRACES to update the valid PAN.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत पर काटा गया कर (TDS) आयकर विभाग के केंद्रीय डेटाबेस में कर्मचारी के 10-अंकीय स्थायी खाता संख्या (PAN) के आधार पर ही क्रेडिट होता है। यदि डीडीओ फॉर्म 24Q में गलत या अमान्य पैन दर्ज कर देता है, तो CPC-TDS उस कटौती को कर्मचारी के कर खाते से नहीं जोड़ पाता। इसके परिणामस्वरूप, वेतन से काटा गया टीडीएस कर्मचारी के 'फॉर्म 26AS' और 'वार्षिक सूचना विवरण' (AIS) में प्रदर्शित नहीं होता। जब कर्मचारी अपना वार्षिक आयकर रिटर्न (ITR) दाखिल करता है, तो कर क्रेडिट उपलब्ध न होने के कारण पोर्टल पर कर मांग (Tax Demand Notice) निकल आती है। इसे सुधारने के लिए डीडीओ को ट्रेसेस पर C3 शुद्धि विवरणी (Correction Statement) दाखिल करनी पड़ती है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) TDS will not reflect in Form 26AS, blocking tax credit claims during filing.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: tax credit claims during filing. If an employee's PAN is recorded as invalid in Form 24Q, the tax deducted from their salary cannot be linked to their tax record. As a result, the TDS will not reflect in their Form 26AS, preventing them from claiming corresponding tax credits while filing their annual income tax return.

questions.question_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 14 के अंतर्गत निम्नलिखित में से किसे एक विशिष्ट "आय का शीर्ष" (Head of Income) के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त नहीं है?
options_hindi: बैंक जमा से आय (Income from Bank Deposits)
गृह संपत्ति से आय (Income from House Property)
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT recognized as a distinct "Head of Income" under Section 14 of the Income Tax Act, 1961?
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 14 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, all income for the purposes of charge of income-tax and computation of total income is classified under exactly five statutory heads of income:
1. Salaries (Sections 15–17)
2. Income from house property (Sections 22–27)
3. Profits and gains of business or profession (Sections 28–44DB)
4. Capital gains (Sections 45–55A)
5. Income from other sources (Sections 56–59).
There is no statutory head called 'Income from Bank Deposits'. Interest earned from savings accounts, fixed deposits, or recurring deposits in banks is assessed under the residual head 'Income from Other Sources' (Section 56).
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 14 के अनुसार कुल आय की गणना के लिए आय को केवल पाँच वैधानिक शीर्षों (Heads of Income) में वर्गीकृत किया गया है:
1. वेतन से आय
2. गृह संपत्ति से आय
3. व्यवसाय या पेशे के लाभ एवं अभिलाभ
4. पूंजीगत अभिलाभ
5. अन्य स्रोतों से आय।
'बैंक जमा से आय' कोई स्वतंत्र शीर्ष नहीं है; बैंक सावधि जमा (FD) या बचत खाते से प्राप्त ब्याज धारा 56 के अंतर्गत 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' शीर्ष के अधीन कर-योग्य होता है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Income from Bank Deposits

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 14 of the Income Tax Act classifies total income under five specific heads: Salaries, House Property, Profits and Gains of Business or Profession, Capital Gains, and Income from Other Sources. Interest earned from bank deposits is classified under Income from Other Sources rather than standing as an independent head of income.

questions.question_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192 के तहत आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के निम्नलिखित कर्तव्यों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए 'वेतन' शीर्ष के तहत कर्मचारी की कुल कर योग्य आय का आकलन करना।
II. लागू दरों पर अनुमानित आय पर देय कर की गणना करना।
III. वेतन भुगतान से प्रत्येक माह समान किस्तों में परिकलित कर की कटौती करना।
IV. प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत कर्मचारी की ओर से वार्षिक आयकर रिटर्न (ITR) दाखिल करना।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following duties of a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) under Section 192 of the Income Tax Act, 1961:
I. Estimating the total taxable income of the employee under the head 'Salaries' for the financial year.
II. Computing the tax payable on the estimated income at the rates in force.
III. Deducting the computed tax in equal monthly installments from salary payments.
IV. Filing an annual income tax return (ITR) on behalf of each individual employee.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english:
Statements I, II, and III are correct, while Statement IV is incorrect.

Under Section 192 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any person responsible for paying salary income must:
1. Estimate the total income of the assessee under 'Salaries' for the financial year (after allowing permissible standard deduction, HRA exemption, and Chapter VI-A deductions).
2. Compute the income-tax payable on such estimated income on the basis of the rates in force for the financial year.
3. Deduct the tax so computed in equal installments during the financial year at the time of each monthly payment.
4. Deposit the deducted tax to the government account and issue Form 16.

Statement IV is incorrect because filing the personal annual Income Tax Return (ITR-1/ITR-2) under Section 139(1) is the exclusive individual responsibility of the employee, not the employer or DDO.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कथन I, II और III सही हैं, जबकि कथन IV गलत है।

आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192 के तहत, वेतन आय का भुगतान करने के लिए जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति (DDO) को निम्नलिखित कार्य करने होते हैं:
1. वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए 'वेतन' शीर्ष के तहत करदाता की कुल आय का अनुमान लगाना (अनुमेय मानक कटौती, HRA छूट और अध्याय VI-A कटौतियों को शामिल करने के बाद)।
2. वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए लागू दरों के आधार पर ऐसी अनुमानित आय पर देय आयकर की गणना करना।
3. प्रत्येक माह वेतन भुगतान के समय समान किस्तों में इस प्रकार परिकलित कर की कटौती करना।
4. काटे गए कर को सरकारी खाते में जमा करना और फॉर्म 16 जारी करना।

कथन IV गलत है क्योंकि धारा 139(1) के तहत व्यक्तिगत वार्षिक आयकर रिटर्न (ITR-1/ITR-2) दाखिल करना कर्मचारी की अपनी व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारी है, न कि नियोक्ता या DDO की।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II, and III only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 192, a Drawing and Disbursing Officer must estimate the employee's annual total income, compute applicable tax liability, and deduct tax in equal monthly installments. However, filing individual income tax returns remains the personal legal duty of the employee and is not part of the employer's statutory responsibilities under this section.

questions.question_hindi:
एक प्रधानाचार्य द्वारा प्राप्त किए जाने वाले आय के निम्नलिखित घटकों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. महंगाई भत्ता (Dearness Allowance)
II. परिवहन भत्ता (Transport Allowance)

IV. मकान किराया भत्ता (House Rent Allowance)
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-से घटक "वेतन से आय" शीर्ष के अंतर्गत आकलित किए जाते हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following components of receipts/income that may pertain to a school Principal or their family:
I. Dearness Allowance
II. Transport Allowance
III. Family Pension received by the surviving legal heir
IV. House Rent Allowance
Which of the components listed above are assessed under the head "Income from Salaries"?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 17(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, payments made by an employer to an employee during or arising out of service—such as Dearness Allowance (DA), Transport Allowance, and House Rent Allowance (HRA)—are classified and taxed under the head 'Income from Salaries'. In contrast, 'Family Pension' received by the surviving spouse or legal heir of a deceased employee is paid after the employee's death. Because there is no employer-employee relationship between the government and the surviving legal heir, family pension is assessable under the head 'Income from Other Sources' under Section 56(2)(ia), subject to standard deduction under Section 57(iia). Therefore, only items I, II, and IV are taxed under Salaries.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 17(1) के अंतर्गत नियोक्ता द्वारा कार्यरत कर्मचारी को प्रदान किए जाने वाले भत्ते जैसे महंगाई भत्ता (DA), परिवहन भत्ता (Transport Allowance) और मकान किराया भत्ता (HRA) 'वेतन से आय' शीर्ष के अधीन कर-योग्य होते हैं। इसके विपरीत, कर्मचारी के निधन के उपरांत उसके विधिक वारिस/आश्रित पति या पत्नी द्वारा प्राप्त 'पारिवारिक पेंशन' पर कोई नियोक्ता-कर्मचारी संबंध लागू नहीं होता, इसलिए इसे धारा 56 के तहत 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' शीर्ष में रखा जाता है (जिसमें धारा 57(iia) के तहत मानक कटौती मिलती है)। अतः केवल I, II और IV ही 'वेतन' शीर्ष के अंतर्गत आते हैं।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II, and IV only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Dearness allowance, transport allowance, and house rent allowance are components paid by an employer to an active employee and are categorized under the head Salaries. Conversely, family pension received by a legal heir is paid after the employee's death and is assessed under the head Income from Other Sources due to lack of employment.

पुरानी कर व्यवस्था के तहत अध्याय VI-A की कटौतियों की सीमाओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

questions.question_english:
Consider the following limits under Chapter VI-A deductions (Old Regime):
I. The aggregate deduction under Section 80C, 80CCC, and 80CCD(1) is capped at ₹1,50,000 under Section 80CCE.
II. Deduction under Section 80CCD(2) for employer's contribution to NPS is over and above the ₹1.5 lakh limit of Section 80CCE.
III. Section 80D allows a deduction up to ₹25,000 for health insurance of self, spouse, and dependent children, plus an additional ₹50,000 for senior citizen parents.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements I, II, and III are completely accurate under Chapter VI-A of the Income Tax Act, 1961: Statement I is correct because Section 80CCE imposes an overarching statutory ceiling of ₹1,50,000 on the combined deductions claimed under Sections 80C, 80CCC, and 80CCD(1). Statement II is correct because Section 80CCD(2) (employer's contribution to NPS up to 14% of salary for Central/State Government employees) is specifically excluded from the Section 80CCE cap and is allowable in addition to it. Statement III is correct because Section 80D permits up to ₹25,000 for non-senior citizen self/family and an additional deduction up to ₹50,000 for parents who are senior citizens (aged 60 years or above).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D (I, II और III) है। तीनों कथन आयकर अधिनियम के अनुसार पूर्णतः सत्य हैं: (I) धारा 80CCE के तहत धारा 80C, 80CCC और 80CCD(1) की संयुक्त कटौती की अधिकतम सीमा ₹1,50,000 है। (II) एनपीएस (NPS) में नियोक्ता का अंशदान (सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए वेतन का 14% तक) धारा 80CCD(2) के तहत धारा 80CCE की ₹1.5 लाख की सीमा के अतिरिक्त अनुमन्य है। (III) धारा 80D के तहत स्वयं व परिवार के स्वास्थ्य बीमा पर ₹25,000 तक तथा वरिष्ठ नागरिक माता-पिता के लिए अतिरिक्त ₹50,000 तक की कटौती प्राप्त होती है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: All three statements are correct under Chapter VI-A provisions. Section 80CCE restricts the cumulative deduction under Sections 80C, 80CCC, and 80CCD(1) to ?1.5 lakh. Employer contributions to NPS under Section 80CCD(2) are explicitly excluded from this cap. Section 80D allows ?25,000 for family health insurance and ?50,000 for senior citizen parents.

questions.question_english: Which of the following defines the condition for relief under Section 89(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 on arrears of salary?
options_english: The employee must be a senior citizen and have no other income from any source
The arrears must be disbursed strictly on the first day of the financial year
The arrears amount must exceed 50% of the employee's basic pay in the current year
The tax payable in the current year on arrears must be higher than the tax that would have been paid had it been received in the respective earlier years
questions.explanation_english: Section 89(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 provides relief to salaried employees when salary arrears, advance salary, or family pension arrears are received in a lump sum in a single financial year, pushing the employee into a higher tax bracket. Relief under Section 89(1) (calculated in accordance with Rule 21A) is admissible only if the tax computed on the total income including arrears in the receipt year exceeds the aggregate tax that would have been payable had the arrears been taxed in the respective years to which they pertain. If there is no additional tax burden caused by the lump-sum receipt, relief under Section 89(1) equals zero.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 89(1) (नियम 21A के साथ पठित) के तहत वेतन के बकाए पर राहत तभी प्रदान की जाती है जब बकाए का एकमुश्त भुगतान प्राप्त होने के कारण चालू वित्तीय वर्ष में कर्मचारी पर पड़ने वाला कर भार उस कुल अतिरिक्त कर से अधिक हो, जो बकाया राशि को संबंधित पूर्ववर्ती वर्षों की आय में जोड़कर गणना करने पर बनता। यदि चालू वर्ष में कर दर में कोई वृद्धि नहीं होती है, तो धारा 89(1) के तहत कोई राहत देय नहीं होती।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The tax in the current year with arrears is higher than the tax that would have been payable in the relevant past years

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Relief under Section 89(1) is available when an employee receives arrears or advance salary resulting in higher tax liability in the receipt year than what would have been incurred had the income been taxed in the respective past years. The mathematical difference between the two tax calculations forms the eligible relief under Rule 21A.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें से एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) कहा गया है:
अभिकथन (A): अपने नामांकित विद्यार्थियों को स्कूल बसों से लाने-ले जाने के लिए परिवहन शुल्क वसूलने वाले विद्यालय को इस शुल्क पर 18% GST लगाना और वसूलना अनिवार्य है।

(A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): A school collecting transportation fees for ferrying its enrolled students in school buses must charge and collect 18% GST on these fees.
Reason (R): Any service provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff, including transportation, is exempt from GST under current notifications.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is false: Under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 (Entry 66, Heading 9992), services provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff are completely exempt from GST. Specifically, transportation of students, faculty, and staff is an exempt educational service. A school cannot levy or collect 18% GST on transportation fees charged to its students.
Reason (R) is true: The GST statutory framework unconditionally exempts core educational and student-support services, including student transportation, catering, and security/cleaning services, provided by educational institutions (up to higher secondary school) to their enrolled students.
Thus, Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) गलत है: केंद्रीय कर (दर) अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017 (प्रविष्टि 66) के अनुसार, किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान द्वारा अपने छात्रों, संकाय और कर्मचारियों को प्रदान की जाने वाली सेवाएं वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) से पूर्णतः मुक्त हैं। विद्यालय द्वारा छात्रों से लिए जाने वाले बस परिवहन शुल्क पर 18% GST नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
कारण (R) सही है: GST नियमों के तहत किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान (विशेषकर उच्चतर माध्यमिक स्तर तक) द्वारा अपने विद्यार्थियों को दी जाने वाली सेवाएं—जैसे परिवहन, भोजन/कैटरिंग, सुरक्षा एवं स्वच्छता सेवाएं—कर-मुक्त सेवाओं की श्रेणी में आती हैं।
अतः अभिकथन (A) गलत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Educational institutions providing services to their enrolled students are exempt from GST under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate). Transportation services supplied by a school to its students form an integral part of exempt educational services, meaning the school cannot collect eighteen percent GST on student transportation fees.

questions.question_english: A Principal, acting as the Head of Office (HOO), engages a local contractor for whitewashing and painting the school building. The total value of the contract payment is ₹40,000. Under which section of the Income Tax Act, 1961 is the DDO required to deduct Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)?
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any person responsible for paying any sum to a resident contractor for carrying out any 'work' (including civil construction, repair, whitewashing, painting, or maintenance) in pursuance of a contract is required to deduct tax at source (TDS).

The statutory threshold limits under Section 194C are:
1. A single contract payment exceeding ₹30,000, OR
2. Aggregate payments to the contractor exceeding ₹1,00,000 during the financial year.

Since the contract payment of ₹40,000 exceeds the individual threshold of ₹30,000, the DDO is legally mandated to deduct TDS under Section 194C (at 1% if the contractor is an individual/HUF, or 2% for corporate/other entities).

Other sections:
- Section 192 applies to salaries.
- Section 194J applies to fees for professional or technical services.
- Section 194A applies to interest other than interest on securities.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 194C के तहत, किसी अनुबंध के अनुसरण में किसी भी 'कार्य' (जिसमें भवन निर्माण, मरम्मत, पुताई/सफेदी, पेंटिंग या रखरखाव शामिल है) को पूरा करने के लिए किसी निवासी ठेकेदार को भुगतान करने वाला व्यक्ति स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है।

धारा 194C के तहत वैधानिक सीमाएँ निम्नलिखित हैं:
1. एकल अनुबंध भुगतान ₹30,000 से अधिक हो, अथवा
2. वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान ठेकेदार को किए गए भुगतानों का कुल योग ₹1,00,000 से अधिक हो।

चूँकि ₹40,000 का अनुबंध भुगतान ₹30,000 की व्यक्तिगत सीमा से अधिक है, इसलिए DDO को धारा 194C के तहत TDS काटना अनिवार्य है (यदि ठेकेदार व्यक्तिगत/HUF है तो 1% की दर से, अथवा अन्य संस्थाओं के लिए 2% की दर से)।

अन्य धाराएँ:
- धारा 192 वेतन भुगतान पर लागू होती है।
- धारा 194J व्यावसायिक या तकनीकी सेवाओं के शुल्क पर लागू होती है।
- धारा 194A प्रतिभूतियों पर ब्याज से इतर अन्य ब्याज पर लागू होती है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 194C of the Income Tax Act mandates tax deduction at source on payments made to contractors for carrying out any work, including maintenance or repair activities like whitewashing. When the payment for a contract exceeds thirty thousand rupees individually or one lakh rupees aggregate annually, the deductor must withhold tax under this section.

questions.question_english: Which statutory form is prescribed under the Income Tax Rules for applying for the allotment of a new Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN)?
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 114A of the Income Tax Rules, 1962, an application for the allotment of a Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN) under Section 203A must be submitted in Form 49B. This form collects organizational details, category of deductor (Central/State Government, autonomous body, etc.), and jurisdictional address. options_english: Taxable supply of service subject to GST.
Exempt because the revenue goes to the government treasury.
Exempt because playgrounds are educational infrastructure.
Classified strictly as a sale of land, falling outside the purview of GST.
questions.explanation_english: Entry 66 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) exempts educational services provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff. When a school leases its premises, playground, or auditorium to a third-party commercial entity for hosting non-educational exhibitions or events, the transaction is treated as 'Renting of Immovable Property Service' under Section 7(1) read with Schedule II of the CGST Act, 2017. This constitutes a commercial supply of service and is fully taxable under GST (generally at 18%). Neither the school's public status nor the deposit of revenue into the treasury confers tax exemption on commercial renting.
questions.explanation_hindi: GST अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017 के तहत छूट केवल छात्रों और कर्मचारियों को दी जाने वाली शैक्षणिक सेवाओं पर लागू होती है। जब कोई विद्यालय अपने परिसर या खेल के मैदान को किसी निजी कंपनी को व्यावसायिक प्रदर्शनी या गैर-शैक्षणिक आयोजन हेतु किराये पर देता है, तो इसे 'अचल संपत्ति का किराया' (Renting of Immovable Property) माना जाता है। CGST अधिनियम की धारा 7 एवं अनुसूची II के अनुसार यह सेवा की कर-योग्य आपूर्ति है जिस पर 18% की दर से GST देय होता है। सरकारी विद्यालय होना या राशि सरकारी खाते में जमा होना इसे कर-मुक्त नहीं बनाता। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: What is the tax implication under the Income Tax Act if a teacher surrenders their earned leaves (Leave Encashment) while in active service (not at the time of retirement or superannuation)?
options_english: It is fully exempt from income tax.
It is taxable only if the total encashment amount exceeds ₹3,00,000.
It is taxed under the head 'Income from Other Sources'.
It is fully taxable under the head 'Income from Salaries'.
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 10(10AA) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, statutory tax exemption on leave encashment applies exclusively to sums received by an employee at the time of retirement, superannuation, or resignation/termination of service:
1. For Central and State Government employees, leave encashment received at the time of retirement is 100% exempt from income tax under Section 10(10AA)(i).
2. However, any leave encashment received by an employee (whether government or non-government) while continuing in active service is treated as 'profits in lieu of salary' under Section 17(1)(va) and is fully taxable under the head 'Income from Salaries'. No statutory exemption is available for in-service leave encashment (though the employee may claim tax relief under Section 89).
Therefore, in-service leave encashment is fully taxable under Income from Salaries.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 10(10AA) के अनुसार, अवकाश नकदीकरण (लीव इनकैशमेंट) पर कर छूट केवल सेवानिवृत्ति (रिटायरमेंट), अधिवर्षिता (सुपरएंनुएशन) या सेवामुक्ति के समय प्राप्त राशि पर ही उपलब्ध होती है:
1. सरकारी कर्मचारियों को सेवानिवृत्ति के समय प्राप्त अवकाश नकदीकरण धारा 10(10AA)(i) के तहत पूरी तरह कर-मुक्त होता है।
2. परंतु, यदि कोई कर्मचारी (चाहे वह सरकारी हो या गैर-सरकारी) सेवा में रहते हुए (In-service) अर्जित अवकाश का नकदीकरण कराता है, तो यह धारा 17(1)(va) के तहत वेतन का हिस्सा माना जाता है और 'वेतन से आय' शीर्ष के अंतर्गत पूर्णतः करयोग्य (Fully Taxable) होता है। इसके लिए धारा 10(10AA) के तहत कोई छूट नहीं मिलती। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Fully taxable under "Income from Salaries".

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Leave encashment received by an employee while continuing in active service is fully taxable under the head Salaries, without any statutory exemption. Tax exemptions for leave encashment under Section 10(10AA) apply exclusively to lump sum amounts received at the time of retirement, superannuation, or voluntary resignation from employment.

questions.question_english: A government school (as a government department) engages a contractor for civil repair works for a contract value of ₹4,00,000 (excluding GST). questions.explanation_english: Under Section 51(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 and corresponding provisions of State GST Acts, TDS under GST is deductible at the rate of 1% CGST and 1% SGST, totaling 2% on intra-state supplies of taxable goods or services when the contract value exceeds ₹2,50,000. Here, the contract value of ₹4,00,000 exceeds the threshold limit of ₹2,50,000, so the school DDO is statutorily bound to deduct 2% in total (1% CGST + 1% SGST) from the taxable payment amount and deposit it with the government.

questions.question_english: In the standard 10-character structure of a Permanent Account Number (such as 'ABCDE1234F'), what does the fourth character denote?
options_english: The precise first letter of the PAN holder's registered last name or surname
The state code where the PAN was issued
The entity status of the PAN holder (e.g., 'P' for Individual, 'C' for Company)
A check digit used for algorithmic validation
questions.explanation_english:
In the 10-character alphanumeric structure of a Permanent Account Number (PAN):
- 1st to 3rd characters: Running alphabetical series from AAA to ZZZ.
- 4th character: Indicates the legal status/entity type of the assessee/holder:
  * 'P' - Individual (Person)
  * 'C' - Company
  * 'H' - Hindu Undivided Family (HUF)
  * 'A' - Association of Persons (AOP)
  * 'B' - Body of Individuals (BOI)
  * 'F' - Firm / Limited Liability Partnership (LLP)
  * 'T' - Trust
  * 'G' - Government Agency
  * 'J' - Artificial Juridical Person
  * 'L' - Local Authority
- 5th character: Represents the first letter of the surname/last name of an individual, or the entity's name.
- 6th to 9th characters: Four sequential numerical digits (0001 to 9999).
- 10th character: An alphabetic check digit.
Therefore, the fourth character denotes the entity status of the holder.
questions.explanation_hindi:
स्थायी खाता संख्या (PAN) की 10-अक्षरीय संरचना में:
- प्रथम 3 वर्ण (1 से 3): AAA से ZZZ तक की वर्णमाला श्रृंखला।
- चौथा वर्ण: करदाता की कानूनी स्थिति/निकाय का दर्जा (Entity Status) दर्शाता है:
  * 'P' - व्यष्टि / व्यक्ति (Individual)
  * 'C' - कंपनी (Company)
  * 'H' - हिंदू अविभाजित परिवार (HUF)
  * 'F' - साझेदारी फर्म / एलएलपी (Firm/LLP)
  * 'T' - न्यास (Trust)
  * 'G' - सरकारी एजेंसी (Government Agency)
  * 'A' - व्यक्तियों का संघ (AOP)
  * 'B' - व्यक्तियों का निकाय (BOI)
  * 'L' - स्थानीय प्राधिकरण (Local Authority)
- 5वाँ वर्ण: व्यक्ति के उपनाम (सरनेम) का प्रथम अक्षर।
- 6 से 9 वर्ण: चार अनुक्रमिक अंक (0001 से 9999)।
- 10वाँ वर्ण: वर्णमाला चेक अंक।

questions.explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A). Under the statutory circulars issued annually by the CBDT governing the deduction of income tax at source from salaries under Section 192, employers/DDOs are explicitly barred from allowing deductions under Section 80G for donations made by employees to private charitable institutions, trusts, or funds. questions.question_english:
Consider the following concepts under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) framework:
I. Input Tax Credit (ITC)
II. Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM)
III. Composition Scheme
IV. Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
Which of these mechanisms requires a government department or public school to deduct 2% tax while making payment to a registered contractor for an invoice/contract exceeding ₹2.5 lakhs?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 51 of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017, government departments, local authorities, and specified governmental agencies are designated as deductors of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under GST. They are statutorily required to deduct tax at the rate of 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST for intra-state supplies, or 2% IGST for inter-state supplies) from payments made to registered suppliers where the total value of taxable supply under a single contract exceeds ₹2,50,000 (excluding taxes). Hence, Mechanism IV (TDS) is the correct answer.
